name: Nouruz, Newroz, Nauroz – Spring Festival
description: The Humboldt Forum celebrates the Persian New Year and the beginning of spring with a lively, diverse festival featuring international artists and traditions. This celebration brings together numerous Berlin-based associations and dedicated individuals for a program combining music, dance, workshops, market offerings, and culinary specialties from Persian, Kurdish, Afghan, and Central Asian cultures. Nouruz is recognized by UNESCO as an Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, and this Berlin celebration embodies the spirit of renewal, hope, and cultural exchange that defines the holiday. The festival runs from 11:00 AM to 9:30 PM with free admission.
